message.content: ChaeSong-hwa initiates the discussion about a karaoke night, suggesting it would be fun to mix things up by adding both classic and pop songs. He proposes starting with "Sweet Home Alabama" or "Let It Be," which are suggested by LiHua as favorites. ChaeSong-hwa also entertains the idea of including their previous favorites along with popular hits like "Shallow" and "Shake It Off." WolfgangSchulz expresses enthusiasm for the proposal, indicating his willingness to attend, and suggests including some upbeat pop songs to diversify the selection. LiHua enthusiastically agrees, stating her eagerness to sing and having a good time. ChaeSong-hwa finalizes the date and time to be this Friday evening, aiming for a fun atmosphere, and looks forward to the event. YurikoYamamoto also expresses excitement and looks forward to trying out some upbeat pop songs. By the end of the conversation, they all seem excited and committed to making the karaoke night a success.
